cohort: The study included 95 children with myelomeningocele treated between 1985 and 2013.
finding: Apgar score, birth length, and WHO Z-score for length were positively correlated with later mobility in children with myelomeningocele.
mod_finding: There was no evidence that cesarean section improved early neurological assessment of children with myelomeningocele.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
